scenes.context: 戴墨镜嘟嘴许愿：墨镜遮眼+嘟嘴的表情反差组合。拍出生日俏皮感。语域：拍照教学，生日场景。
sentences: Wear sunglasses and pout out a wish.
pout out a wish（嘟嘴许愿）
墨镜遮眼加嘟嘴，反差组合。
Covered eyes plus a pout — a contrast combo.
paraphrase: 嘟嘴 → pout / pucker the lips
反差组合 → contrast combo / playful mismatch
scenes.speak: Wear sunglasses and pout out a wish. Covered eyes plus a pout — a contrast combo. It brings out the playfulness.

scenes.context: 拿蛋糕仰头笑：蛋糕做前景+仰头避双下巴+自然笑容。利用道具加分。语域：拍照教学，道具运用。
sentences: Hold the cake and laugh with your head up.
蛋糕当前景，仰头避双下巴。
Cake as foreground, chin up to avoid the double chin.
keep the laugh natural（笑容自然）
paraphrase: 前景 → foreground / in the front
双下巴 → double chin / under the chin
scenes.speak: Hold the cake and laugh with your head up. Cake as foreground, chin up to avoid the double chin. Keep the laugh natural.

scenes.title_en: Muffled Laugh with a Resting Hand
scenes.context: 捂嘴笑搭手：半遮面制造俏皮感，单手搭放保持松弛。手势自然不刻意。语域：拍照教学，手势技巧。
sentences: Muffle the laugh, one hand resting.
Half-covering the face makes it playful.
Keep the hand relaxed, not posed.
paraphrase: 捂嘴 → muffle / cover the mouth
scenes.speak: Muffle the laugh, one hand resting. Half-covering the face makes it playful. Keep the hand relaxed, not posed.

scenes.context: 张嘴笑：最释放的表情，作为组图的情绪高潮。用来结束整组照片。语域：拍照教学，收尾表情。
sentences: The open-mouth laugh is the most releasing expression.
它作为组图的情绪高潮。
It's the emotional peak of the set.
Use it to close out the set.
close out the set（结束组图）
paraphrase: 情绪高潮 → emotional peak / the climax
scenes.speak: The open-mouth laugh is the most releasing expression. It's the emotional peak of the set. Use it to close out the set.

practice: Wear sunglasses and pout out a wish.
Cake as foreground, chin up to avoid the double chin.
Muffle the laugh, one hand resting.
The open-mouth laugh is the emotional peak of the set.
pitfalls: Wear sunglasses and pout out a wish.
「嘟嘴」用 pout，配合墨镜做反差。
Cake as foreground, chin up to avoid the double chin.
「蛋糕做前景」用 foreground，仰头避双下巴。
Half-covering the face makes it playful.
The open-mouth laugh is the emotional peak.
「张嘴笑」是 open-mouth laugh，最释放的表情。
shifts: 用 pout out a wish（嘟嘴许愿）、contrast combo（反差组合）、playful mismatch（俏皮错位）
用 foreground（前景）、double chin（双下巴）、close out the set（结束组图）
用 releasing expression（释放的表情）、emotional peak（情绪高潮）、half-covering（半遮面）
